promptEs: En Mi mayor, ¿cómo se cifra el dominante secundario que resuelve en V?
promptEn: In E major, how is the secondary dominant that resolves to V labelled?
explanationEs: En Mi mayor, el dominante de V es Fa♯7 y se cifra V/V. Resuelve en Si (V): su tercera es la sensible de Si y sube un semitono.
explanationEn: In E major, the dominant of V is F♯7 and it is labelled V/V. It resolves to B (V): its third is the leading tone of B and rises a semitone.
